export_evidence: importkey.com/countries/india/krishana-export and /krishana both returned only the empty page template: "Shipments available for KRISHANA EXPORT, refreshed daily" — a boilerplate placeholder with zero shipment rows rendered (0 rows seen of an unstated counter; the page shows no counter value at all). No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code was visible. volza.com/p/krishana-export, eximpedia.app/companies/krishana-export and trademo.com/companies/krishana-export all returned HTTP 403; web_search backend was down (connection refused) and Google returned HTTP 429, so no second source could be read.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split found. No search engine was reachable to look for them (web_search: connection refused; Google: HTTP 429; DuckDuckGo: timeout), so absence of evidence here reflects tool failure, not a verified absence.
note: Name is ambiguous: 'Krishana' is a common Indian trade name and the claimed legal form 'KRISHANA EXPORT' could not be tied to a specific entity — no CIN, PAN, state or address was supplied, so no registry match was attempted (registries out of scope anyway). Declared HS codes 090831 (cardamom) and 220299 (non-alcoholic beverages) are plausible for an Indian agri/FMCG exporter but nothing confirms either line. No shipment record, no B/L, no GST figure and no tender was actually seen; per Rule 5 this is 'следов поставок не найдено' in the accessible sources, but because the lookup tools themselves failed I record export_status and domestic_status as unknown rather than none_found — the check must be repeated with working search access and a disambiguated legal name before any verdict.
